senses.definition: Any domestic animal that lacks an enclosure, proper place, or company, but that instead wanders at large or is lost; an estray.
(literally or figuratively) A person who is lost.

(historical) An area of common land for use by domestic animals.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To wander from company or outside proper limits; to rove or roam at large; to go astray.
(intransitive) To wander from the path of duty or rectitude; to err.
